documentation.content: @SERVICE@ answered 3 or more 5xx in 5 minutes. A 503 on /health or /stream is an instance draining or full (concurrency 1); a burst of them is not. What to do: ops/monitoring/README.md section 5xx, then docs/RUNBOOK.md.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name="@SERVICE@" AND metric.label.response_code_class="5xx"
